messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the statutory holidays that create a **long weekend** (i.e., a three‑day weekend) in Canada for the year 2023.  
*Long weekend* means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on the adjacent weekday), giving you a continuous break from Friday to Sunday (or Monday to Wednesday).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Provinces/territories where the holiday is observed (and any special observation rules) |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sun | ✔️ (Observed Mon Jan 2 in most provinces) | All provinces & territories; observed on Monday if Sunday falls on holiday |
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Mon | ✔️ | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario (third Monday in February) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Fri | ✔️ | All provinces & territories (except Quebec, which observes Easter Monday instead) |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (Friday) | Fri | ✔️ | Ontario (statutory holiday on March 17) |
| **St. George’s Day** | Apr 23 (Thursday) | Thu | ✔️ | Prince Edward Island (statutory holiday on April 23) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | Mon | ✔️ | All provinces & territories (last Monday before May 25) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Sat | ✔️ (Observed Mon Jul 3 in some provinces) | All provinces & territories; observed on Monday if Saturday falls on holiday |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Mon | ✔️ | All provinces & territories (first Monday in September) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Mon | ✔️ | All provinces & territories (second Monday in October) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Sat | ✔️ (Observed Mon Nov 13 in some provinces) | All provinces & territories; observed on Monday if Saturday falls on holiday |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Mon | ✔️ | All provinces & territories (observed on Monday) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tue | ❌ | All provinces & territories (not a long weekend) |

### Quick notes

* **Observed dates** – In many provinces, if a statutory holiday falls on a weekend, the holiday is “moved” to the nearest weekday (usually Monday). This still gives you a long weekend because you’ll have the weekend plus the observed weekday off.
* **Province‑specific holidays** – The table above includes the major statutory holidays that affect the entire country. Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patricks’ Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in PEI) that also create long weekends.
* **Quebec** – Quebec does not observe Good Friday; instead, it observes Easter Monday. However, the rest of Canada still gets a long weekend on Good Friday.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
